name: Disney's Pop Century Resort
theme: A walk through 20th-century pop culture, decade by decade, across the lake from Art of Animation.
transport: Disney Skyliner gondolas to Epcot and Hollywood Studios
Buses to Magic Kingdom, Animal Kingdom, and Disney Springs
author: Ryan

quickFacts.label: Category and price
quickFacts.value: Value resort in the Wide World of Sports area. In 2026 a Standard Room ran about $213 to $404 a night at full price, tax included, depending on dates.

quickFacts.label: Getting to the parks
quickFacts.value: Skyliner gondola to EPCOT and Hollywood Studios, with a quick change at the Caribbean Beach hub. Buses to Magic Kingdom, Animal Kingdom, Disney Springs and the water parks.

quickFacts.label: Room size
quickFacts.value: About 260 sq ft [verify], sleeping up to 4 adults. Every room is the same: 1 queen bed plus a queen pull-down bed that folds into a table, or 1 king. The four room categories only change location and view.

quickFacts.label: Best for
quickFacts.value: Budget-minded families with young kids who want easy EPCOT and Hollywood Studios days. Tight for four adults, and not the pick if the pool or resort dining is the point of your trip.

quickFacts.label: Food
quickFacts.value: Everything POP food court for breakfast, lunch and dinner, plus Petals Pool Bar. There's no table-service restaurant on site.

quickFacts.label: Pools
quickFacts.value: Three pools: the flower-shaped Hippy Dippy Pool with a kiddie splash area, plus the smaller Bowling and Computer pools. No hot tubs.

heads: The Skyliner is closed Jan 24–30, 2027 (buses fill in), and on EPCOT Extended Evening Hours nights the Skyliner route to Pop Century stops running early.

name: Disney's Art of Animation Resort
theme: Themed to animated films, with most rooms set up as family suites.
transport: Disney Skyliner gondolas to Epcot and Hollywood Studios
Buses to Magic Kingdom, Animal Kingdom, and Disney Springs
author: Ryan

quickFacts.label: Category and price
quickFacts.value: Value resort in the Wide World of Sports area, next to Pop Century. In 2026 a Little Mermaid Standard Room ran about $251 to $443 a night at full price, tax included. Family Suites ran about $519 to $992, depending on the theme and dates.

quickFacts.label: Getting to the parks
quickFacts.value: Skyliner gondola to EPCOT and Hollywood Studios, with a change at the Caribbean Beach hub. The station is on the Generation Gap Bridge and is shared with Pop Century. Buses to Magic Kingdom, Animal Kingdom, Disney Springs and the water parks leave from Animation Hall.

quickFacts.label: Room size
quickFacts.value: Little Mermaid rooms are about 277 sq ft [verify] and sleep up to 4 adults, with 1 king bed or 2 queen beds. Family Suites in the Cars, Finding Nemo and Lion King sections are about 565 sq ft [verify], sleep up to 6, and have two bathrooms, a kitchenette, a queen bed, a double sleeper sofa and a double pull-down bed.

quickFacts.label: Best for
quickFacts.value: Families of five or six who want suite space and two bathrooms at a Value price, especially if EPCOT and Hollywood Studios are high on the list. The Little Mermaid rooms suit smaller parties on a tighter budget, but they are a longer walk from the lobby.

quickFacts.label: Food
quickFacts.value: Landscape of Flavors is the food court in Animation Hall, open for breakfast, lunch and dinner. The Drop Off pool bar sits by the Big Blue Pool. There's no table-service restaurant on site; Everything POP at Pop Century is a walk across the bridge.

quickFacts.label: Pools
quickFacts.value: Three pools: the Big Blue Pool in the Finding Nemo courtyard, which Disney calls the largest hotel pool at Walt Disney World, plus the Cozy Cone Pool in the Cars courtyard and the Flippin' Fins Pool in the Little Mermaid courtyard.

heads: The Skyliner is closed Jan 24–30, 2027 (buses fill in), and on EPCOT Extended Evening Hours nights the Skyliner route to Art of Animation stops running early.

quickFacts.label: Category and price
quickFacts.value: Deluxe resort in the Magic Kingdom area, on the Seven Seas Lagoon. In 2026 a Resort View room ran about $832 to $1,370 a night at full price, tax included. Water View rooms ran about $864 to $1,506, depending on the dates.

quickFacts.label: Getting to the parks
quickFacts.value: Resort monorail to Magic Kingdom, and to EPCOT with a change at the Transportation and Ticket Center. A boat (the Gold Launch) runs to Magic Kingdom and also serves the Polynesian Village. Buses go to Hollywood Studios, Animal Kingdom and Disney Springs.

quickFacts.label: Room size
quickFacts.value: Standard hotel rooms are about 448 sq ft [verify] and sleep up to 5 adults, with 2 queen beds and a day bed, or 1 king bed and a day bed. Most standard view rooms are in the outer buildings. Club Level rooms and suites are a separate set of categories, some of them larger.

quickFacts.label: Best for
quickFacts.value: Families who want monorail or boat access to Magic Kingdom and a lot of dining on site, including a character buffet. Theme Park View rooms look toward the park. It is a Deluxe price at the high end of the scale, so it is not the pick if the nightly rate is the main concern.

quickFacts.label: Food
quickFacts.value: This is one of the biggest dining resorts on property. 1900 Park Fare is the character buffet for breakfast and dinner. Grand Floridian Cafe, Cítricos, Narcoossee's and Victoria & Albert's are table service. Gasparilla Island Grill is the quick-service spot, and Enchanted Rose and Garden View Lounge are the lounges.

quickFacts.label: Pools
quickFacts.value: The Beach Pool is the main pool, at 111,261 gallons, with a 181-foot slide, a waterfall, zero-depth entry and a splash area for little kids. The Courtyard Pool is a quieter, heated zero-entry pool behind the main building, with a whirlpool spa.

heads: Renovations continue in select areas, including the porte cochere, through early 2027. Disney says guests may see or hear work during the day or need to take alternate paths.

quickFacts.label: Category and price
quickFacts.value: Deluxe resort in the Magic Kingdom area, on the Seven Seas Lagoon. In 2026 a Resort View room ran about $771 to $1,371 a night at full price, tax included. Water View rooms ran about $876 to $1,446, depending on the dates.

quickFacts.label: Getting to the parks
quickFacts.value: Resort monorail to Magic Kingdom, and to EPCOT with a change at the Transportation and Ticket Center. A walking path also leads to the TTC. A boat (the Gold Launch) runs to Magic Kingdom and also serves the Grand Floridian. Buses go to Hollywood Studios, Animal Kingdom and Disney Springs.

quickFacts.label: Room size
quickFacts.value: Standard hotel rooms are about 415 sq ft [verify] and sleep up to 5 adults. Most are set up with 2 queen beds and a day bed. Some Resort View rooms have 1 king bed and a day bed, or 2 queen beds. Honeymoon Club Level rooms sleep 2, with 1 king bed.

quickFacts.label: Best for
quickFacts.value: Families who want monorail or boat access to Magic Kingdom, and anyone who cares about on-site dining. Theme Park View rooms look across the lagoon toward the park. It is a Deluxe price, so it is not the pick if you are mainly watching the nightly rate.

quickFacts.label: Food
quickFacts.value: This is a dining resort. 'Ohana serves a character breakfast with Lilo and Stitch, plus a family-style dinner without characters. Kona Cafe is table service for breakfast, lunch and dinner. Capt. Cook's and Chip 'n' Dale's Deli are the quick-service spots, and Pineapple Lanai is the walk-up window for pineapple soft-serve. Trader Sam's Grog Grotto is the themed bar.

quickFacts.label: Pools
quickFacts.value: The Lava Pool is the main pool, with a volcano, a waterfall, a 142-foot slide and zero-depth entry. The Oasis Pool is a quieter garden pool. Guests can also use the Cove Pool and Moana's Voyage splash area at Island Tower.

heads: Disney has listed construction on the front drive and bus area from May 2025 through 2026, and exterior maintenance starting Jan 15, 2026, that may block lagoon views from 'Ohana. Restaurants, pools and amenities were planned to stay open. [verify if this work is still underway]
